before: Before writing or revising any image or video prompt, read the full [animation principles](references/animation-principles.md) and the applicable [image](references/image-prompt-writing.md) or [video](references/video-prompt-writing.md) guide. These are required, including for realistic products and simple shots. Already injected full current rules count as read; a summary or catalog does not. Apply only relevant principles: images express a readable pose, weight, support and selected moment; videos express causality, speed changes, contact, follow-through and timing. Do not paste principle names into the output. Model-specific syntax and limitations are supplied by the selected model, outside this Skill.
after: Prompt writing belongs to agents assigned the image-prompt or video-prompt Skill. Direction defines the intended staging and performance; the assigned prompt author converts that design.
